order: source parquet filenames lexicographic, then row-group index ascending, then row position ascending; global row index counts all rows including rejected rows
selection: first 5 unique source_float32 SHA256 waveforms satisfying all original metadata conditions; shard/row order unchanged; deduplicate before inference, with no model-quality filtering
conditions: speakers contains nonempty text, finite nonnegative start/end and start<end for every segment
number of distinct speaker_id equals num_speakers
no pair of different speakers overlaps by more than one audio sample (1/16000s)
audio_policy: full published waveform, no cropping/denoising/VAD; mono PCM16/16kHz WAV quantized from source float array
reference_policy: published text and speaker segments copied independently of model output; canonical RTTM without VAD boundary editing
uniqueness: SHA256 of source float32 little-endian mono samples, before PCM conversion; first eligible row for each unique waveform wins

amendment.reason: Initial first five metadata-matching rows contained exact duplicate waveforms (294/297 and 346/348). Five records means five unique source recordings. Original files and selection audit retained under initial-* and original row names.
amendment.authorization: Parent explicitly authorized amendment before first inference; no inference results used.
